events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season starts around mid-October. Includes 2-3 social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and 1-2 adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. Regular season with races and practices. Races typically start in March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May. January includes 2-4 indoor training opportunities. February has 1 weekend practice per week. March-May has 2 rides per week including weeknight and weekend practices.
